title: Chamber — Room Acoustics Studio
description: Draw a room, give every surface a material, trace sound rays through it, then hear the result and export the impulse response.
concept: Chamber is a working acoustics lab in one file. Your floorplan is extruded to a ceiling height and thousands of rays leave the source in random directions, losing energy to each material they strike in three frequency bands plus air loss, and reporting what reaches the listener's two ears after every bounce — the diffuse-rain method real acoustic simulators use. Those arrivals become a per-ear energy histogram, which is turned into a true stereo impulse response, read for RT60 / EDT / C50, and convolved with synthesised test signals so you can actually hear the room you drew. Reshape a corner, swap carpet for tile, and the decay curve and the reverb change together.
features: Floorplan editor: drag corners, insert and remove them, concave rooms traced correctly
14 surface materials with per-band absorption and scattering, assignable per wall plus floor and ceiling
3D ray tracer (walls + floor + ceiling) with air absorption, diffuse rain receiver and binaural ears
Eight room presets from a tiled bathroom to a stone nave, plus animated ray paths over the plan
Analysis: Schroeder decay curves, RT60 (T30), EDT, Sabine estimate, C50/D50 and the IR waveform
Audition: six synthesised test signals convolved live with the traced impulse response, dry/wet mix
Export stereo IR .wav, rendered audition .wav, room .json, shareable URL and localStorage room slots

interaction.mouse: Drag room corners, the amber source, the blue listener, or the listener's nose to turn the head; wheel zooms the plan.
interaction.click: Tools insert or delete a corner and pick a wall; presets, material menus, Trace and Audition buttons drive the rest.
interaction.touch: Every drag, tool and slider is pointer-based, and the panel becomes a bottom sheet under 900px.
interaction.keyboard: R traces, Space auditions, 1–4 switch tools, Esc closes the help sheet.
